# Lot & Loaded

Lot & Loaded originates off-market commercial parcels — industrial land, redevelopment and teardown sites — and puts them under contract at 65% of builder value. Builders are qualified on closing pace and see deals that fit their buy box. Partners register parcels with the house, locked for 30 days, and keep 50% of the collected fee. Free to join; the house makes money when deals close.

## Key facts
- Off-market commercial land and teardown sites, priced at 65% of builder value
- Buyer qualification is based on closing pace; qualification takes about three minutes
- Partner-registered parcels are locked to the registering partner for 30 days
- Partners keep 50% of the fee the house collects on their deals
- Owners can sell directly: cash, as-is, no listing, no broker fees
